notes: Snap to Edge no longer parks a panel partly off the screen. Snapping the OG Widget to the top pushed its first 32 pixels above the display, cutting off its title bar; left and right were off by the same amount. It now sits flush against…

Cause: every panel window can reserve a margin around its visible surface for glow and shadow effects, and each theme declares its own — the Gauge 2 theme reserves 50 pixels, while OG, Gauge, Flow and Blackfield reserve none. The snap was…

The same wrong figure was also being used when resetting a panel's appearance, which sized those windows 64 pixels larger than their contents and left a dead transparent border. Both are fixed by the same change.

Fixed in one place rather than at each point of use. The identical mistake had already been corrected once, on its own, in the code that moves a panel to another monitor — leaving every other caller still wrong. That local correction now…
